intro.body: Thinking about sharing your car with others? Here you can check whether your car is eligible to join our fleet and get an estimate of how much you could earn. We'll ask you a few questions about your car and how you use it—it only takes a couple of minutes.

hero.title: Share your car, share the costs
hero.subtitle: More than 580 happy owners already share their car. Enjoy all the benefits of Dégage.
hero.intro: Is your car often parked but giving it up feels like a step too far? Want to buy an electric car but don't want to carry the costs alone? Car sharing through Dégage could be right for you.
hero.ctaHint: Free eligibility check. Takes a few minutes.

flexible.title: Your car when you need it
flexible.desc: You keep control of your schedule. Reserve your own trips and set the rules for your car.

environment.title: Good for the planet
environment.desc: Fewer cars on the road means less emissions and smarter use of what we already have.

community.title: Social, livable neighborhood
community.desc: Sharing brings people in your area closer together, for mobility with a human touch.

eligibility.title: Does your car qualify?
eligibility.body: We check whether your car fits our shared fleet. Run the free simulation to find out and see what you could earn back.

costSharing.title: Share the costs (and drive cheaper)
costSharing.body: Purchase, insurance, tax, maintenance, inspection… A car is expensive, especially when it sits idle. For every kilometre someone else drives with your car, you get money back. Many owners save hundreds to thousands of euros per year.
costSharing.exampleDesc: When others drive 14,000 km with your car while you drive 6,000 km yourself, fixed costs and depreciation are spread over more kilometres, and you get paid back.

advantages.title: Dégage: share your car without worries

about.title: What is Dégage?
about.paragraph1: All shared cars and bikes belong to individuals, like you, and are shared within the community.
about.paragraph2: Dégage is a fast-growing community of more than 550 owners and 7,000 members. We pursue no profit, but affordable, reliable and accessible mobility.
about.paragraph3: By sharing cars and bikes with each other, Dégage brings people back in touch with one another. We have been doing this for more than 25 years, independent and self-sufficient. And we are proud of that.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.imageAlt: Dégage shared cars in the neighbourhood

schedule.q: Can I share when I want?
schedule.a: Yes. You reserve your own trips according to your schedule. Set filters such as maximum booking length or how far in advance others can book.

insurance.a: Yes. Dégage has a group insurance policy tailored to car sharing. If you are not at fault in an incident, you pay nothing.

effort.q: Is sharing a lot of work?
effort.a: No. You choose how to hand over keys. Dégage handles all billing. Every three months you receive your share back.

freedom.title: Share your car via Dégage: freedom and environmental awareness combined

playConnector.panelBody:
Connect with the email and password you use on the legacy Dégage platform (Degapp). We need this to sync your account during onboarding — including enrolling for an info session and pre-filling your contact details.

This is not your password for this app. Your Degapp credentials are stored encrypted.

infoSession.panelBody:
Choose an upcoming owner info session and enroll. Enrolling unlocks the next preparation steps.

You can only be enrolled in one session at a time. After you attend, an admin will confirm your presence — only then is this step fully complete.

roadAssistancePlan.title: Road assistance plan
roadAssistancePlan.subtitle: Your roadside assistance coverage
roadAssistancePlan.info: Tell us whether your car already has road assistance and choose the plan you want with Dégage.
roadAssistancePlan.panelBody:
Dégage offers roadside assistance free of charge to every owner. By default this is VAB Benelux.

If as an owner you want VAB roadside assistance in Europe, you can request it 7 days before departure. That cover remains valid until the end of the calendar year. Dégage also pays for this request.

carValue.title: Car value
carValue.subtitle: Agreement on depreciation per shared km
carValue.info: Review the proposed car value and depreciation. Agree or submit a counter proposal.
carValue.panelBody:
Your car's value is used to set the insurance premium. We estimate that value from the details you entered during the simulation.

Based on that value we also determine the depreciation per shared kilometre. For an existing car we propose a value; you can agree or submit a counter proposal with your reasoning. For a purchased car we use the purchase price.

carStickers.title: Car stickers
carStickers.subtitle: Choose your sticker designs
carStickers.panelBody:
Visibility matters for Dégage. A sticker also helps our members recognise the car quickly. You always get the green sticker. Want extra stickers? Choose which ones you want below.

If you want a sticker on the side door, one of our volunteers will contact you to apply it. The white slogan sticker is easy to apply yourself.
